title: Credit for the Paid Term on a Professional Email Pro Upgrade
content:
Billing standard for the credit a Professional Email Pro upgrade gives for the term already paid. The charge that opened the current term is the new-subscription or renewal charge whose period start is the term start date; an added-seat or upgrade line never opens a term.

**Credit basis.** The credit basis of a Pro upgrade is read from the charge that opened the current term:
- where that charge covers the whole term, the credit basis is its amount, counted once;
- where it is the first monthly instalment of an annual term billed monthly, the credit basis is its amount, counted for each of the calendar months from the term start date to the term end date;
- otherwise, where no charge on record opened the current term, the credit basis is the current product's annual-prepaid seat price times the upgraded seats times the upgrade months, counted once.

A Pro upgrade charge is a proration line, so no account-tier rate and no other percentage ever reduces it; the account tier reaches it only through what the charge that opened the current term recorded.

## Examples (hypothetical charges)

| Charge that opened the current term | Credit basis | Counted for |
|---|---|---|
| a renewal charge of 1180.40 covering a 12-month annual prepaid term | 1180.40 | once |
| a first monthly instalment of 98.70 on a 12-month term billed monthly | 98.70 | 12 months |
| none on record, 15 seats, current annual-prepaid seat price 3.99, 12 upgrade months | 15 times 3.99 times 12, that is 718.20 | once |
